title: Product FAQ Localization & Translation Governance

root_cause.defect: product_faq() regeneration applied only to English root pages, never to locale pages
root_cause.systemic_gap: body content (product pages) has no regeneration/drift-detection mechanism, unlike header/footer (build_locale_ui.py + audit_locale_ui.py, Phase 2)

products_out_of_scope: sugar-s30-supplier.html (bespoke regulatory FAQ, no generic template, no locale FAQ at all)

governed_source_chain: scripts/sync_faq_schema.py (pre-existing, re-run to sync FAQPage JSON-LD)

audit_protection.method: regenerates expected FAQ markup in-memory from governed source, byte-compares to live page

regression_test.step1: reintroduced English text on ar/1121-basmati-rice-exporter.html visible FAQ

findings.title: Stale/absent product FAQ translations across 83 products x 10 locales
Pre-existing inverted accordion open/close JS logic on all locale product-page FAQs
findings.discovered_via: Part N browser testing (accordion open/close check)
findings.evidence: git diff shows zero changes to the affected <script> block across all touched files
findings.reason_not_fixed: outside this phase's authorized scope (FAQ text/translation governance, not FAQ component JS); recommended for a focused follow-up phase

findings.title: sugar-s30-supplier.html locale pages have no FAQ section at all (bespoke regulatory English content, never templated)
findings.severity: LOW (pre-existing, narrow scope: 1 product x 10 locales)
findings.reason_not_fixed: bespoke legal/regulatory content requiring dedicated review, not a mechanical template fill

human_review.translations_status: all 50 new template translations are draft_pending_native_review
human_review.arabic_at_sight: resolved by removal -- the disputed payment-terms question does not exist in the current English FAQ design and is not carried forward

results.failed_requests_cause: external Wikimedia image on sugar-s30-supplier.html, unreachable from sandboxed test env, unrelated to FAQ fix
